entries.zh: 发抖，颤抖；兼指风瘫之症
entries.en: to tremble, shake; also palsy, a shaking (paralytic) illness
entries.notes: 官话对音栏[残]，据西语temblar与汉字瘓互证，瘓兼风瘫之义。

entries.zh: 抖得很厉害，连连发抖；如树梢颤动
entries.en: to tremble greatly, shake repeatedly; as the quivering of a tree
entries.notes: 西文'la ʒa del arboc'难辨，姑作'树（梢）'解；瘓瘓叠言与temblar mucho相合；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to tremble in the hands and feet from fear
entries.notes: '忌'为音写，忌脚忌手即手脚打颤之惧态；官话栏[残]。

entries.zh: 因病颤抖，如风瘫之症（瘓風）
entries.en: to tremble from sickness, as in palsy / paralysis
entries.notes: porlesia当作parálisis（瘫痪），瘓風为风瘫症名；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to shiver, tremble with cold
entries.notes: 寒那瘓＝冷到发抖；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to shiver with cold (variant of the foregoing entry)
entries.notes: 汉字'逐'与义不合而原稿音写chûn同'瘓'，疑俗写别字，条前圈出；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: earthquake; the earth trembles (entry struck through in the manuscript)
entries.notes: 原件此条划有删线，地動即地震；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: earthquake; the earth quakes and shakes
entries.notes: M栏三音节（地-震-動）而汉字栏仅'地震'，疑漏'動'字，条前圈出；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to quake, shake (of the earth in an earthquake)
entries.notes: 据震動与temblar la tierra互证；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: the hands tremble, shake uncontrollably
entries.notes: '雲'（原稿音写fy）疑为'暈/昏'类借音字，谓手抖而晕乱；官话栏[残]。

entries.zh: 怕，害怕（驚）；惊惶；惊骇；受惊
entries.en: to fear, be afraid; to be frightened, alarmed; to be startled
entries.notes: 词头下连列quy hon（当为'驚惶'）、quy hay（当为'驚駭'）等复词，末alborota（惊动）或为邻项引导；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to fear, be afraid (reduplicated)
entries.notes: M栏[残:尾字難辨]，'xor~'未可定字；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to fear, dread; to fear / stand in awe of
entries.notes: M栏后段'qua. con res pal~'[残:尾字難辨]未可确解，仅据忌、畏（uy）可释义；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to fear, dread; to be afraid
entries.notes: 第三音'hoy'字未可确考，懼字条前圈出；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to fear, dread; to be afraid that, lest
entries.notes: quyong' cû.当为'恐惧'，qiong pa'.当为'恐怕'，余'qiong uy / cau ley'诸音未可全定；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字'雲'（音写fy）与temer恐惧义无涉，疑借音字或邻条错位，义不可考；官话栏[残]。

entries.zh: 发怔，惊呆；（续文）无论何物皆怕
entries.en: to be stunned, dazed; (phrase) to fear anything whatsoever
entries.notes: 'xoy hay goy'三音未可确字，西文'temer qualquira co~a'当为temer cualquier cosa（怕任何东西）；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to palpitate with fear; heart-throb from fright
entries.notes: M音'hay xûn'与'悸'通常音读不合，疑记异读或别字；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to tremble with fear (as in the classical 觳觫, quaking)
entries.notes: 觳与temblar de miedo义合（觳觫：惧而战栗）；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: to dread, stand in awe of; to shrink from
entries.notes: 据憚与temer互证（畏惮、忌惮）；官话栏[残]。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西文句'敬畏并服从长上'（temer y obedecera el superior，教规语境）可读，但汉字'業'（音写giap）与之不合，疑栏位错行或别字，义不可考；官话栏[残]。
